title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the best environments for focused academic work at Aurora University, from quiet library carrels to collaborative campus lounges.

cards.title: Collaborative Zone at Phillips
cards.subtitle: Active study area with mobile whiteboards
cards.notes: Utilize the rolling whiteboards to map out group projects or practice presentations in this high-energy collaborative space.
cards.short_summary: The first floor of Phillips Library is designed for group work and features mobile whiteboards for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor encourages collaborative group work and popular among students are the rolling whiteboards that are used to practice presentations.
cards.source_title: Student Services - Academic Catalogs - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.–9 p.m. during regular semesters; requires student ID for certain services.

cards.title: Silent Carrels for Deep Focus
cards.subtitle: Dedicated quiet floor for individual work
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a strictly quiet environment. The individual study carrels are ideal for long reading sessions and exam prep.
cards.short_summary: The second floor of Phillips Library is a dedicated quiet zone featuring study carrels for individual focus.
cards.evidence_claim: The second floor is dedicated to individual work, and students will find study carrels and a quieter environment to stay focused.
cards.source_title: Student Services - Academic Catalogs - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Accessible during standard library hours; quiet protocols are strictly enforced on this level.

cards.entity_name: Wackerlin Center for Faith and Action
cards.title: Retreat-Style Study at Wackerlin
cards.subtitle: Cozy lounge seating in a prairie-style building
cards.notes: Find a spot in the lounge or the private study room for a peaceful, retreat-like atmosphere away from the main campus hub.
cards.short_summary: The Wackerlin Center offers cozy, quiet spaces for individual and group study in a serene, prairie-style setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can find cozy, quiet spaces for individual and group study, including a private study room and plenty of lounge seating.
cards.access_notes: Located at 430 S. Evanslawn Ave; can be requested for after-hours use if needed.

cards.title: Social Study at The Spot
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Stephens Hall
cards.notes: Grab a booth at this social hub for casual studying. It is a great place to review notes while having a quick meal.
cards.short_summary: Located in Stephens Hall, the Spartan Spot serves as both a dining area and a social study space for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Located in the lower level of Stephens Hall, the Spot is also a social gathering place and study area.
cards.source_title: Guide for New Students and Families - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner hours; accessible to all students with a valid ID.

cards.title: High-Tech Focus in Dunham Hall
cards.subtitle: General use Windows computer lab
cards.notes: Use one of the 43 Windows workstations for software-heavy assignments or printing needs in this modern academic building.
cards.short_summary: Dunham Hall 010 is a large general-use computer lab available for student academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunham Hall 010 43 Windows Computers... open for general student use.
cards.source_title: Computer Lab Hours and Locations - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours for general student use; check ITS page for specific daily schedules.

cards.title: Cafe Vibes at Institute for Collaboration
cards.subtitle: First floor coffee shop seating
cards.notes: Enjoy a specialty coffee while working in the open seating area of the Institute for Collaboration's first floor.
cards.short_summary: Tru Blu Coffee provides a cafe-style study environment within the Institute for Collaboration building.
cards.evidence_claim: Tru Blu Coffee, located on the first floor of the Institute for Collaboration, offers a variety of specialty coffee drinks... and grab and go snacks.
cards.source_title: Student Services - Academic Catalogs - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Open during daytime hours; seating is open to students regardless of purchase.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection in Eckhart Hall
cards.subtitle: Third floor sanctuary space
cards.notes: Visit the third floor of Eckhart Hall for a silent, contemplative space perfect for reading or quiet reflection between classes.
cards.short_summary: Lowry Chapel in Eckhart Hall is used by students for quiet reflection and silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Located on the third floor of Eckhart Hall, this space can be used for religious services... Faculty, staff, and students use this space for quiet reflection.
cards.access_notes: No food or drink allowed; open for quiet use when not reserved for services.

cards.title: Residential Study at Centennial
cards.subtitle: Second floor elevator lobby area
cards.notes: Residents can use this dedicated room for late-night sessions without leaving the building. It is located conveniently near the elevator.
cards.short_summary: Centennial Hall features a dedicated study room on the second floor for its residents.
cards.evidence_claim: For those students looking for a space to study outside of their residence hall room, a study room is located on the second floor of the building.
cards.access_notes: Requires student ID card access; restricted to residential students 24/7.

cards.title: Spacious Study in Memorial Hall
cards.subtitle: Dedicated resident academic space
cards.notes: Take advantage of the free printing and spacious layout in this residence hall study room, shared with Davis Hall residents.
cards.short_summary: Memorial Hall provides a large study room with free printing for residential students.
cards.evidence_claim: Residents also enjoy the additional amenities of a centralized laundry room... a spacious study room, 24/7 fitness room, and vending machines.
cards.access_notes: 24/7 access for residents of Memorial and Davis Halls via dual-scan entry.

cards.title: Resource-Rich Study at Hill Center
cards.subtitle: Academic support and career lounge
cards.notes: Study in a professional environment where academic advisors and career resources are just a few steps away.
cards.short_summary: The Hill Center for Student Success offers lounge areas where students can study and access academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kimberly and James Hill Center for Student Success prepares students for meaningful and successful careers... Spartan Tip: You may often find free snacks.
cards.access_notes: Located at 1433 Prairie Street; accessible via south entrance during business hours.
